metadata.name: Better Mods Menu
metadata.description:
[h1]Better Mods Menu[/h1] The vanilla Mods menu, redrawn with the game's own paper sprites and fonts and made actually usable with a big mod list. This mod is fully vibe-coded.
[b]Requires REPENTOGON.[/b]
[list] [*] The page stays still and the list scrolls smoothly under its header [*] Mod covers next to the names (see Covers below), a gear on mods that have settings, category stamps (API / CONTENT / QOL / VISUAL) and a pending-change marker [*] Info card: name, version, Workshop id, tags, cover and the description [*] Dependency warnings when an enabled mod needs one that is off; press D to enable what is missing [*] Filters (Q/E or LB/RB): all, on, off, pinned, API, content, QoL, visual, changed, broken. Empty ones are skipped [*] Sorting (S): by name, enabled first, by category [*] Pinned mods (B) always stay on top [*] Profiles (P): save up to 4 mod sets, plus "as at game start" and "everything off" [*] REPENTOGON search (CTRL) and undo (BACKSPACE) keep working [*] Settings of other mods (O) from Mod Config Menu and Dead Sea Scrolls, right on the page [*] The game's own menu sounds for moving, switching mods on and off and changing values [*] Gamepad: d-pad, A toggles, LB/RB filter, LT/RT page, Y panels; Y saves a profile, B cancels a key binding wait [*] F2 switches back to the plain vanilla list [*] English and Russian (follows the game language, L to switch) [/list]
Settings changed here are written into the mod when a run starts, after it has loaded its own config. A change that can't be applied yet (mod missing or failing) waits for the next run. Dead Sea Scrolls buttons that need a run stay greyed out.
Mods are still switched by the game itself, so nothing about saving changes. Applying a profile walks the cursor through every mod that has to change; press ENTER once per mod.
[h2]Covers[/h2] Mods can't reach the internet, so covers come from your disk: a mod's own thumb.png (if it is a real PNG) is shown automatically. To get the Workshop pictures of all your mods, run [i]tools/make_thumbs.py --download[/i] from this mod's folder once (Python 3 + Pillow) and restart the game. Without any covers the list simply has no cover column.
Source: https://github.com/Full-Time-Krist/better-mods-menu
